moa: Atezolizumab is a humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody that binds PD-L1, blocking its interaction with PD-1 and B7.1, thereby releasing PD-1/PD-L1-mediated inhibition of cytotoxic T cells and restoring antitumor immune activity.

REACTOME_CD28_DEPENDENT_PI3K_AKT_SIGNALI.description: Regulates T-cell activation via CD28 and PI3K/AKT signaling.
REACTOME_CD28_DEPENDENT_PI3K_AKT_SIGNALI.interpretation: Critical for T-cell activation and proliferation, enhancing immune response against tumors.

REACTOME_CO_STIMULATION_BY_CD28.description: Involves CD28-mediated co-stimulation of T cells.
REACTOME_CO_STIMULATION_BY_CD28.interpretation: Enhances T-cell activation and survival, important for effective immune response.

BIOCARTA_MHC_PATHWAY.description: Involves antigen presentation via MHC molecules.
BIOCARTA_MHC_PATHWAY.interpretation: Essential for T-cell recognition of tumor antigens, influencing immune response.

KEGG_T_CELL_RECEPTOR_SIGNALING_PATHWAY.description: Pathway involved in T-cell receptor signaling.
KEGG_T_CELL_RECEPTOR_SIGNALING_PATHWAY.interpretation: Facilitates T-cell activation and response to tumor antigens.

notes: Limited data on resistance pathways in breast cancer; see citations.
